ConnectionStrings._comment: Local dev value lives in .NET user secrets (dotnet user-secrets set ConnectionStrings:Postgres ... --project P2P.Api), never committed. This placeholder is intentionally non-functional.

Jwt._comment: Local dev signing key lives in .NET user secrets (dotnet user-secrets set Jwt:SigningKey ... --project P2P.Api), never committed. This placeholder is intentionally non-functional (too short for HmacSha256).
